copied_package_smoke.scope: One copied-package generation call on each supplied public example and one saved-text reflow call. Known development smoke checks; not fresh competition or an unseen benchmark. Uses the already installed pinned dependency modules through explicit paths.

deferred_raster_ablation.scope: Known cases; same candidates and layout work; one timing observation per arm.

rendered_text_reviewer.scope: Bounds intersections, not confirmed ink collisions or generalized competitor superiority.

native_edit_limit: API tests are not full GUI certification; complex edits retain known failed hit checks. Reflow requires matching model and supports text edits only.
fresh_ci: Template prepared; publishing an active workflow requires additional GitHub workflow authorization. Remote CI not verified.
